title: Emerging investigator series: identification and transformation of per/polyfluoroalkyl substances (PFASs) in residential wastewater and effluent from alternative treatment systems
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, 27,1810-1822
DOI: 10.1039/D5EM00134J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Rachel Smolinski, Meghan Oates, Arjun K. Venkatesan, Christopher J. Gobler, Carrie A. McDonough
Onsite wastewater treatment systems are seldom assessed for the removal of trace organic compounds. Here, we demonstrate a comprehensive approach to analyze, identify, and characterize PFAS in onsite wastewater.
